title: Democratic Rights
subtitle: Understanding the Foundations of Our Freedom
subject: Social Science - Civics
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the meaning of rights in a democracy
Identify fundamental rights provided by the Indian Constitution
Analyze the importance of these rights in daily life
Understand how rights are protected and enforced

ai_context.learning_goal: Student should master the concept of fundamental rights and their role in a democratic society.
common_misconceptions: Rights are absolute and have no restrictions.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to imagine a society without any rules or guaranteed freedoms. What would it look like?
